reference: MAME 0.276 assistant clone; Apollo DN3500; Domain/OS SR10.4 / HP VUE 2.01
action: A one-frame Shift pulse was applied through the Apollo keyboard field and automatically released on frame 3. The screen was captured on frame 65.
result: The VUE desktop and File Manager returned visibly. The hook remained uncaptured and mouse_device remained none. No guest file or configuration was changed.
limits: Confirms keyboard wake on this clone, not the user's physical screen-activation sequence. The visible XmpIcon grid has no selected item, keyboard focus outline, hover or rubberband state.
